title: Coding model guarded load and speed check
scope: Take over from the private Windows handover: independently re-verify the downloaded coding weights, then load them once on the existing portable runtime with partial GPU offload and memory guards and record load feasibility, memory and speed on a generic non-CPIN coding prompt. summary: Coding weights independently re-hashed and match the pinned digest. Two single guarded load attempts (32 and 36 GPU layers) were both stopped by the available-RAM guard during loading with about 4 GiB RAM free; no output generated, so speed and coding quality remain unmeasured. Both stopped attempts preserved privately. CPIN trial task untouched and still blocked.
